verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for an agent framework that also offers Mastra Cloud, so the axis applies. However, no evidence documents choosing a storage region or residency. The self-hosted model gateways keep prompts from reaching external models, which is an adjacent privacy control rather than data-storage location. Deploying to Vercel, Netlify or Cloudflare is a host-platform capability, not a residency feature of Mastra itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
